thread:
Renee: Quick flag launch week numbers  dashboard shows signups spike but downstream demos didn't budge. wondering if this is an attribution/windowing issue or haul from partner syndication. thoughts?
Marco: noticed the spike too. looks like a social burst + a partner cross-post. partners sometimes append weird UTMs which split attribution.
Sofia: ran a shallow check. two LPs receiving traffic: /webinar and /product-trial. The launch post used CTA 'Watch demo' but social feed had variant CTAs. split in creative + UTMs could explain conversion drop.
Ibrahim (Analytics): i'm running a quick cohort compare. snippet:```-- compare 7d last-touch vs 30d first-touch
SELECT method, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users, SUM(signed_up) as signups
FROM marketing.attribution
WHERE campaign LIKE '%launch%' AND event_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY method;```
notify-bot: "Marketing KPI" dashboard refreshed by Ibrahim :bar_chart:
Kai (Ops): small ops note: our ingest pipeline lowercases utm_source but not utm_campaign. that's probably creating variants. i can add a normalize step but need a quick patch PR.
Renee: don't change headline attribution mid-week. action plan: (1) Ibrahim to produce last-7d vs first-30d table for the deck, (2) Kai to patch ingestion to normalize utm_campaign and run a backfill for the last 48h, (3) Sofia to surface CTA variant CTRs.
Ibrahim (Analytics): exported both cohorts and csvs: https://bigquery.cloud.redwood/exports/launch_compare_194000.csv. early result: first-touch 30d attributes 18% more trials to the webinar cohort than last-touch 7d.
Marco: that suggests delayed conversions. also, check routing: if utm variants map to different SDR queues, outreach might be misaligned reducing demo conversion.
Kai (Ops): started the normalize patch. will run a one-off rehydrate job after tests. estimate ~90 minutes. will tag merged rows with dedupe_reason=utm_normalize.
Sofia: CTA split results: 'Watch webinar' CTR 3.2%, 'Request demo' CTR 1.1% on the same post. most of the trafficked users landed on webinar LP. can Marketing Ops change the next paid push to favor webinar CTA?
Renee: yes, let's favor webinar CTA for top-funnel. keep demo CTA for retargeting. Also ask SalesOps to hold outreach on flagged leads until rehydrate completes.
Ibrahim (Analytics): rehydrate completed, merged 640 duplicates. dashboard re-run shows conversion ratios aligned with expected baseline. pushed dashboard note: "UTM variants from partner caused split attribution; normalized and merged leads 194000."
Kai (Ops): PR merged and patch deployed to staging. will schedule the ingest normalization in prod tonight.
Sofia: i'll update the weekly deck with the two attribution views and the CTA performance table for the KPI huddle.
Renee: thanks all. assign follow-ups in Asana: ingestion patch (Kai), post-mortem note (Marco), deck blurb (Sofia). closing loop at tomorrow's KPI sync. :white_check_mark:
